title: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2609.05488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. R

translated_title: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN：先验引导的临床轨迹联合概率预测
translated_abstract: 临床恶化是通过耦合的、部分观测的轨迹逐步演变的，而非单一的诊断标签。我们提出了PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN，一个以轨迹为先的多变量生理指标联合概率预测框架。它融合了缺失感知的时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特异性关系、非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息传递机制以及低秩多变量Student-t输出头。我们在一个冻结的基于MIMIC-IV的队列（包含6,882名患者和54,694个时间窗口）上评估了24小时病史和6小时预测任务。在五个随机种子和13个对比模型的实验中，PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN取得了第二低的归一化MAE（0.37727 ± 0.00029）和最低的RMSE（0.52656 ± 0.00034）。相比确定性TimeKAN，它将MAE降低了0.52%。在概率预测方面，它达到了0.66380的边际NLL和0.27301的CRPS。在标称50%、80%和95%置信区间下，经验覆盖率分别为0.533、0.831和0.958。
tldr: 提出了PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN框架，通过器官系统先验引导和概率建模对多变量生理临床轨迹进行联合预测，在MIMIC-IV队列上取得了最低RMSE且概率校准性能优异。
en_tdlr: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN is a prior-guided framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate clinical trajectories, achieving the lowest RMSE and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates on a MIMIC-IV-derived cohort.
